summary: [payments-api] Fast test runner always passes --no-cov flag
body: Pytest runs in under 2 seconds when coverage instrumentation is disabled via --no-cov. Relevant identifier: `--no-cov`.

summary: [payments-api] Password hashing algorithm is strictly argon2id
body: Passlib is configured with argon2id using memory_cost=65536 and time_cost=3. Relevant identifier: `argon2id`.

summary: [payments-api] SQLite connection sets busy_timeout=5000 for lock contention
body: Pragma busy_timeout is set to 5000 ms to avoid immediate database locked errors. Relevant identifier: `busy_timeout=5000`.

summary: [payments-api] Vector extension requires sqlite-vec v0.1.6 or newer
body: Vector virtual tables vec0 use partition keys starting from sqlite-vec v0.1.6. Relevant identifier: `sqlite-vec v0.1.6`.

summary: [payments-api] WAL journaling pragma synchronous=NORMAL is enforced
body: Sync normal reduces disk fsync operations without sacrificing WAL durability. Relevant identifier: `PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL`.

summary: [payments-api] Token schema header format is auth_jwt_v2
body: Authorization header bearer tokens must conform to the auth_jwt_v2 envelope schema. Relevant identifier: `auth_jwt_v2`.

summary: [payments-api] Stripe payment webhook verification uses stripe_webhook_secret
body: Webhook signatures are validated against stripe_webhook_secret in environment. Relevant identifier: `stripe_webhook_secret`.

summary: [payments-api] Redis connection pool size is capped at redis_pool_size=20
body: Asyncio connection pool limits concurrent connections with redis_pool_size=20. Relevant identifier: `redis_pool_size=20`.

summary: [payments-api] External HTTP requests enforce MAX_RETRIES=3 with exponential backoff
body: HTTP client retry adapter sets MAX_RETRIES=3 on network timeouts. Relevant identifier: `MAX_RETRIES=3`.

summary: [payments-api] Event ingestion uses dedicated kafka_consumer_group
body: Consumer group offset commits are tracked by kafka_consumer_group. Relevant identifier: `kafka_consumer_group`.

summary: [payments-api] Warehouse sizing defaults to snowflake_warehouse_xs
body: ETL queries scale horizontally starting on snowflake_warehouse_xs. Relevant identifier: `snowflake_warehouse_xs`.

summary: [payments-api] Data export files must use parquet_snappy_compression
body: Batch dumps written to cloud storage use snappy compression inside parquet files. Relevant identifier: `parquet_snappy_compression`.

summary: [payments-api] Background task execution enables celery_task_acks_late
body: Workers acknowledge task completion only after execution to prevent task loss. Relevant identifier: `celery_task_acks_late`.

summary: [payments-api] ASGI web server runs with uvicorn_workers=4 per container
body: Production deployment spawns 4 worker processes per task container. Relevant identifier: `uvicorn_workers=4`.

summary: [payments-api] Cold storage bucket naming requires s3_bucket_prefix=archive
body: Long term historical backups are routed to buckets starting with archive. Relevant identifier: `s3_bucket_prefix=archive`.

summary: [payments-api] Minimum connection pool floor set to DB_POOL_MIN_SIZE=5
body: Database pool maintains warm idle connections with DB_POOL_MIN_SIZE=5. Relevant identifier: `DB_POOL_MIN_SIZE=5`.

summary: [payments-api] HTTP payload size ceiling capped at MAX_REQUEST_SIZE_MB=10
body: Nginx reverse proxy rejects requests exceeding MAX_REQUEST_SIZE_MB=10. Relevant identifier: `MAX_REQUEST_SIZE_MB=10`.

summary: [payments-api] Exponential backoff retry policy includes full random jitter
body: To avoid thundering herd problem against downstream APIs, retries add random uniform jitter up to 1000ms.

summary: [payments-api] Graceful shutdown drains in-flight requests within 30 second window
body: SIGTERM handler stops accepting new connections and permits running requests 30s before forceful kill.

summary: [payments-api] API mutation requests require idempotency key header for safe retries
body: POST and PATCH operations check client provided Idempotency-Key header against cache for 24 hours.

summary: [payments-api] Circuit breaker trips to open state after 5 consecutive upstream timeouts
body: When failure rate reaches threshold, circuit enters open state for 60 seconds before testing recovery.

summary: [payments-api] Database connection pooling limits idle connections and recycles hourly
body: Pool connections are recycled every 3600 seconds to prevent stale TCP sockets behind AWS NLB.

summary: [payments-api] Token bucket rate limiting allocates 100 requests per minute per IP
body: Excess requests receive HTTP 429 Too Many Requests with a Retry-After header calculated from bucket refill.

summary: [payments-api] User authentication sessions expire after 24 hours of inactivity
body: Rolling inactivity timer invalidates session cookie in Redis if no authenticated request arrives within 24h.

summary: [payments-api] PII access operations write tamper-evident audit log entries
body: Any read of customer personally identifiable information publishes an immutable audit event to security sink.

summary: [payments-api] Composite index on project_id and created_at required for timeline queries
body: Query planner avoids sequential scans on large tables by leveraging B-tree index on project and timestamp.

summary: [payments-api] API private keys and encryption secrets rotate automatically every 90 days
body: Dual-key verification window allows a 24-hour overlap when master encryption keys rotate.

summary: [payments-api] Service level objective error budget threshold set at 99.9% uptime
body: Feature deployments freeze if monthly failure budget drops below remaining threshold.

summary: [payments-api] Ephemeral debugging traces purged automatically after 14 days
body: Diagnostic telemetry logs expire and get purged by daily vacuum cleaner job to minimize storage footprint.

summary: [payments-api] Zero-downtime database migrations mandate backward-compatible column additions
body: Columns must be added as nullable or with defaults before application code references them in release N+1.

summary: [payments-api] Liveness probes return 200 independently of external service dependencies
body: Liveness probe must not check database or cache status to prevent orchestrator restarting healthy nodes.

summary: [payments-api] Cache stampede protection utilizes distributed mutex lock during recalculation
body: When cache key expires, only the lock holder recomputes the payload while other requests wait.

summary: [payments-api] Distributed trace headers W3C tracecontext must be propagated across service calls
body: Outgoing HTTP requests must inject traceparent and tracestate headers from active context.

summary: [payments-api] Cross-origin resource sharing policy restricts allowed origins to company domains
body: Access-Control-Allow-Origin header strictly validates against whitelist regex before returning 200.

summary: [payments-api] Monolithic single database used for all multi-tenant storage
body: Initial MVP used a single global PostgreSQL database with tenant_id columns on every table.

summary: [payments-api] Per-project SQLite database with local isolation adopted
body: Migrated to isolated per-project SQLite files in ~/.mem-plane to ensure zero cross-tenant blast radius.

summary: [payments-api] JWT tokens signed with symmetric HMAC-SHA256 secret
body: Shared secret key stored in environment was used for signing and verifying tokens.

summary: [payments-api] JWT tokens signed with asymmetric Ed25519 public-private keypairs
body: Replaced HMAC with Ed25519 keys so verification services only need the public key.

summary: [payments-api] Batch export format was gzipped CSV files
body: Nightly customer exports generated large .csv.gz archives.

summary: [payments-api] Batch export format upgraded to Apache Parquet with zstd compression
body: Switched to columnar Parquet files resulting in 70% storage savings and faster analytic queries.

summary: [payments-api] REST polling used for async payment status updates
body: Frontend clients polled /status endpoint every 2 seconds until transaction completed.

summary: [payments-api] Server-Sent Events SSE stream used for real-time payment notifications
body: Replaced polling with persistent SSE connection reducing server load by 85%.

summary: [payments-api] Default password minimum length was 8 characters
body: Legacy user registration required passwords with at least 8 characters.

summary: [payments-api] Password minimum length increased to 14 characters without complexity rules
body: Adopted modern NIST guidelines requiring minimum 14 characters and checking HaveIBeenPwned API.

summary: [payments-api] Docker container base image used ubuntu:22.04
body: Microservices were packaged on Ubuntu base image with full standard packages.

summary: [payments-api] Docker container base image migrated to distroless minimal runtime
body: Switched to Google distroless containers eliminating package managers and shell binaries for security.

summary: [payments-api] Memory cache provider was Memcached cluster
body: Application caches used a cluster of Memcached nodes with binary protocol.

summary: [payments-api] Memory cache provider standardized on Redis with Redis Sentinel failover
body: Replaced Memcached with Redis to support complex data structures and atomic operations.

summary: [payments-api] Log aggregation delivered via self-hosted Elasticsearch
body: Application logs were shipped to a self-managed 3-node Elasticsearch cluster.

summary: [payments-api] Log aggregation transitioned to Grafana Loki with object storage
body: Migrated to Loki to avoid heavy Java heap management and indexing costs.
